n62a143b9b7.headline: Housing in Vilnius will remain unaffordable for some time: what we can expect in the future
n62a143b9b7.summary: Economists indicate that housing affordability in Vilnius and other Baltic capitals remains low, making home ownership a distant prospect for many residents.
n62a143b9b7.why: Housing affordability affects consumer spending, household wealth, and financial stability, influencing broader economic growth and policy decisions.

nea398ac29d.summary: Tunisia's Assembly of the Representatives of the People began debating the 2024 state budget and finance bill amid ongoing economic challenges and political stability.
